rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: Nice work! That was a wonderful performance, and an outstanding expression of how you all feel.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: Now I'm very much looking forward to how you do after you debut...

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: I'll be sure to keep you in mind for that festival.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Ah, speaking of which...
I brought some good news with me today.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Your wait is over...
Your debut date has been set.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aaaaaah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're finally gonna make our debut...! I really get to debut with Ichi, Hona and Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There's some other stuff we've gotta do first, but still...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It feels like a dream, but it totally isn't!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. It feels like just yesterday we were throwing everything we had at our first video upload or our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If I told past me about all this, she wouldn't believe it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...
But, this isn't the finish line!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As pros, we've gotta write songs that'll really reach people!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Maybe I can get an idea of who's listening to our songs if I look at the comments online.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see, I'll pull up one of the videos we uploaded... Oh, here's some comments!

rows.Speaker: Video Comment
rows.Line: <I've been feeling down lately since I did bad on my finals, but I feel like this helped>

rows.Speaker: Video Comment
rows.Line: <I pull this up whenever something goes wrong in life. It's so soothing.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It sounds like we're reaching these people. Through our performance...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What else...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (The person who left this comment seems really upset about getting compared to their talented sister.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (The comment under that is from someone who's decided to work for their family's sake, even though they actually want to go to college instead...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Oh... This person must feel conflicted about getting made a team regular when their senior is on the bench...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (There really are so many people out there with all sorts of worries and doubts...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If we keep making music, will these people get to look up a bit or feel less stressed?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aaalright! I'm fired up now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There's still some time before I should be going to bed, so I'll think up some phrases and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, huh?
My phone's all lit u—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Line: Oh, I'm in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well that's weird. I was using my phone, but I didn't play Untitled, did I...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That light...!
I think it's the same as when my phone lit up!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, there!

rows.Line:
I'm pretty sure this ball thingy is what made that light just now.
What is it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Miku and the others might know about it, so I'll go show them!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, it's glowing again?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey! Too bright...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sheesh, that sudden flash scared me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I've got no clue what's going on.
Anyway, I should see what Miku and the others...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wh-Where AM I?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on?!
I was in SEKAI just now, wasn't I?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So why am I in this...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This... Uh, yard?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now that I'm actually looking, this place is super cute! It's full of the kinda stuff I like!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Does whoever lives here love this stuff too?
I bet we could be best friends!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's it!
If whoever lives here is home, maybe I can ask them where I am!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Excuse meee! Is anybody around?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm, maybe they're out?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, this yard is so cute...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Maybe I'll take a peek around while I search for whoever lives here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Pardon me!
